links.outcome: Accuracy of AI-generated ketogenic diet macronutrient and calorie calculations across three vignettes
links.effect: All three chatbots failed to produce accurate KD plans; Classic KD menus did not match calculated macronutrient targets, giving inaccurate ketogenic ratios; MCT menus had less MCT than prescribed; MAD exceeded net carbohydrate limits.
links.quote: All three chatbots failed to produce accurate KD plans.

links.outcome: Appropriateness of food choices and safety of AI-generated ketogenic diet plans
links.effect: For the MAD, chatbots exceeded net carbohydrate limits and provided inappropriate food suggestions; plans judged unsafe and unreliable by dietitians.
links.quote: For the MAD, the chatbots exceeded the specified net carbohydrate limits and provided inappropriate food suggestions.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and safety of AI chatbots (ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini) generating ketogenic diet plans across three clinical vignettes without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
